author: Aleex_ii
quote:
I was going to delete my review when I saw that nonsense about the review bombing, but I don’t want to keep quiet.

My rating would be 7.5–8 because you can spend many hours playing in the open world and it’s fun, but I’m lowering it for two reasons: poor performance and the 30 fps (the game is set to be the GOTY 2026, and it’s unacceptable for it to be released like this).

Almost 30 hours, and my takeaway is:
Very good, realistic graphics.Boring storylines.
Flat and irritating main characters.Huge map with plenty of things to do.
Poor optimisation, closer to a stable 20 fps than 30.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: It completely ruins what its predecessor achieved; it’s a game that adds nothing and offers no innovation. It continues a story that had been wrapped up perfectly, only to deliver a mediocre, verging on poor, conclusion.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: Aleex_ii
quote: A game that is perfect in every way, a genuine 10 out of 10 and one that has gone down in history. I wish they’d realised what worked about it and stopped milking it with remakes and sequels that don’t measure up and tarnish a legend.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: One of the best Pokémon series, with a good story and impressive graphical details, although overall the graphic style leaves something to be desired. The Pokémon animations are very good. A series that has been overlooked by TPC, and one that we hope to see return with a new instalment (and new gameplay).

author: Aleex_ii
quote: The best Pokémon game ever made; years go by, yet the story remains one of the best told, presented and accessible. I wish there were more games with this kind of storytelling and artistic direction.
game_title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky

author: Aleex_ii
quote:
The pinnacle of the Pokémon video game series.
Graphics, music, art style, extras, characters (both visual and written), story, and world-building.
Quite simply the best Pokémon RPG.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: Bayonetta – that’s all it needs; it delivers exactly what it promises: great gameplay, spectacular music and beautiful graphics.I’d give it a 9–10, but the hardware limitations mean I have to lower the score.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: Quite simply, the best GOW I’ve ever played: graphics, music, story, gameplay…For me, it’s one of those games that will go down in history and influence many others.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: After years of playing it, now that its successor has finally been released, I can only marvel at what this game was (and still is).

author: Aleex_ii
quote: A brilliant game, though not quite as good as its **** hard as few others, with a perfect soundtrack.

author: Aleex_ii
quote:
For me, this is THE GAME – I’ve bought it on various platforms and completed it 100 per cent. Quite simply, for me, it’s the best game I’ve ever played.
Sorry not sorryt

author: Aleex_ii
quote: My biggest disappointment of the year – I wasn’t quite sure what to expect from this game, but even in my worst nightmares I wouldn’t have imagined a game this bad.
game_title: God of War Sons of Sparta

author: Aleex_ii
quote: My surprise of the year and my Game of the Year for 2026. Hours and hours of gameplay – you set **** and end up doing loads of other things until you remember what you were actually going to do.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: I was expecting more from this so-called Classic +, but it hasn’t been a bad experience – it’s just no different from what I experienced before.

author: Aleex_ii
quote: Basically, it’s the perfect remake of the perfect game.They’ve made only the minimal and necessary changes, and although it still has its imperfections like any game, it’s almost a must to play it at least once in your life.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
